brief:
Palestinian prisoners' center reported that 350 children are held in occupation prisons, including three girls, facing torture, starvation, medical neglect, and denial of visits, according to Shehab Wire. The detainees endure systematic mistreatment including violations of their rights and international humanitarian law.

The center's findings cover conditions facing Palestinian minors in the detention system, documenting allegations of harm to their physical and psychological welfare during prolonged incarceration.

title: Palestinian center says occupation prisons hold 350 children in torture conditions
